item.title: China’s factory activity slips as new export orders weaken
item.description: China's factory activity contracted in October, reversing the previous month's reboujnd. The National Bureau of Statistics reported Saturday that the official purchasing managers' index fell to 49.3, down from 50.1 in September.

item.title: Meet the 'socialist' progressive Democrats likely on their way to Congress
item.description: There’s been a lot of talk this midterm election season about socialism. But only a handful of candidates running for Congress actually align with the far-left wing of the party or consider themselves part of the Democratic Socialists of America.

item.title: G20 foreign ministers to end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issues

item.title: From salmonberry harvests to traditional tattoos, Native American culture is spotlighted in November
